device_mismatch.title: myAir reports a different CPAP device for {title}
device_mismatch.description:
This entry is configured for CPAP device {configured}, but myAir now reports device {reported}. The entry's sensors stay unavailable while myAir reports the other device, so data from that device does not appear under this entry's sensors.

If you replaced your CPAP device, add the integration again to set up the new device, then delete this entry. This issue clears if myAir reports {configured} again.
